packet_dag.terminal_condition: REQ-20260712-101 through REQ-20260712-107 have terminal status, with visual approval required before merge or deploy.

title: One Time landing visual revision implementation packet

reasons: The operator requested exact public landing copy, order, carousel, ticker, visual treatment, signup field behavior, and screenshot proof.
The request explicitly blocks merge and deploy until desktop and mobile screenshots are approved.
The executable scope is one public acquisition surface with two public routes and one public assistant widget.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time public landing and direct signup
likely_external_provider_blockers: operator screenshot approval before merge or deploy
final classroom and teaching-location imagery not yet supplied

operator_intent_summary: Implement a focused One Time public landing visual and copy revision with exact hero copy, revised section order, enhanced section visuals, dynamic Rosh Hashanah ticker, contained Robot Scheller image, and direct signup city/timezone correction. Present screenshots before merge or deploy.
raw_quotes: Start from a clean branch/worktree based on current origin/master.
Do not merge or deploy this visual revision until desktop and mobile screenshots are presented for approval.
Give your son a love for learning Torah.
Permit any city; store entered city exactly.

decisions_captured.decision: Merge and deploy require operator screenshot approval.
Prompt reference screenshot path is unavailable locally.

out_of_scope: No merge or deploy before operator screenshot approval.
No external sends, payment, access grant, DNS/account mutation, WAPI dispatch, Telegram dispatch, or production-data mutation.
No authentication, portal-access, reminder-dispatch, or signup endpoint change except the requested city/timezone normalization.
No fabricated final classroom photographs; placeholder image panels must remain labeled as pending.

known_current_defects: Old hero used a longer heading, paragraph, and proof boxes.
Feature and benefit sections used older labels and plain card treatment.
Static Rosh Hashanah section did not calculate days.
Signup required choosing a city from a fixed list.
Robot Scheller avatar used background-image styling.
current_state.missing_reference_blocker: Prompt screenshot path /workspace/scratch/ffef2e71fe52/upload/8d1a83ad-4652-409b-869d-269e98173323.png is not present on this machine.

expanded_phrases.modern: Use responsive public-page layout, keyboard-safe controls, reduced-motion support, and restrained movement.
expanded_phrases.premium: Use the One Time black/yellow/ice-blue palette with layered surfaces, chrome accents, readable type, and purposeful icons.
expanded_phrases.clean: For this packet, clean means the git worktree/branch starts from current origin/master without unrelated local edits.
expanded_phrases.professional: Verify exact copy, section order, accessible states, responsive screenshots, and registry coverage before handback.
expanded_phrases.working: Visible actions must route, submit, toggle, or pause with testable behavior and no fake success state.
expanded_phrases.configured: Use existing repo assets and route/action registries; missing external assets are blockers or labeled placeholders.
expanded_phrases.CRM: Keep lead creation in first-party BNA/One Time data paths only; no external CRM runtime or provider write is part of this packet.

requirements.statement: Use a clean current branch/worktree and preserve the unrelated stale branch lane.
requirements.expected_result: Implementation happens in a separate current worktree with no merge or deploy.
acceptance_criteria: Branch starts from current origin/master.
Stale commit lane is not used.
Merge and deploy remain blocked pending approval.

requirements.statement: Revise the One Time public landing route with the exact section order, exact hero copy, revised feature labels, benefit copy, flow, audience cards, and signup links.
requirements.expected_result: The public landing matches the requested content structure and all signup links target /one-time/signup.
acceptance_criteria: Old hero paragraph and proof boxes are absent.
What You Receive, What He'll Gain, How It Works, and Who It's For use requested labels and copy.
All public signup CTAs link to /one-time/signup.

requirements.statement: Add the bottom Rabbi section, teaching-location carousel, and separate press-logo marquee.
requirements.expected_result: Rabbi copy, photo, carousel controls, pagination, pause/focus/swipe behavior, and press marquee are present.
acceptance_criteria: Rabbi section uses the requested eyebrow, heading, paragraph, and book photo.
Carousel has placeholder slides for requested locations.
Press logos remain a separate transparent marquee.

requirements.statement: Replace the static Rosh Hashanah section with a dynamic non-fixed ticker above the footer.
requirements.expected_result: Ticker calculates days to the Jerusalem calendar date 2026-09-11 and links Sign Up Now to /one-time/signup.
acceptance_criteria: Visible day count is calculated in JavaScript.
Ticker pauses on hover/focus and has a reduced-motion static state.
Ticker is not fixed and does not cover the bot.

requirements.statement: Render Robot Scheller from the approved PNG as a contained image in closed and open states.
requirements.expected_result: Robot is fully visible in launcher and panel header while current-class helper copy still works.
acceptance_criteria: Launcher uses an img with object-fit contain.
Panel header robot does not cover title, close, text, or actions.
Current class information prompt still returns class context.

requirements.statement: Change signup city capture to free text plus detected or fallback IANA timezone.
requirements.expected_result: Any city can be submitted, stored exactly, and paired with an IANA timezone for local class-time display.
acceptance_criteria: No hardcoded city datalist or matching-city validation remains.
browser_timezone and timezone are stored.
Manual timezone field appears when detection fails.
Phone remains required only for WhatsApp or both.

requirements.statement: Produce local verification, screenshots, and closeout matrix without merge or deploy.
requirements.expected_result: Evidence is ready for operator visual approval and deployment remains blocked.
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots cover 1440, 1024, 768, 430, and 390.
Robot, countdown, reduced motion, signup payload, and no-overflow checks are recorded.
Final handback states no merge/deploy occurred.

criteria: Control tower and current-state visual audit exist.
